xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4683: pan start --remote re-plans an already-planned issue (looks for the spec only on the primary checkout)

plan.title: pan start --remote re-plans an already-planned issue (looks for the spec only on the primary checkout)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan start <id> --remote decides whether a plan exists with findSpecByIssue(projectRoot, id), which reads only the primary checkout. A planned issue's spec is committed on feature/<id>, so the lookup misses and --remote launches a second planning session (seen live on PAN-4677). Two related gaps: complete-planning's detached bare `git push` always fails because workspace branches track origin/main (branch.<b>.merge=refs/heads/main), so the Fly VM's `git fetch origin feature/<id>` finds no spec; and the post-planning auto-start (and the deferred hand-off retry) POSTs /api/agents with no location, so the work agent that `pan start --remote` promises starts locally.
narratives.Proposal: (1) New findIssuePlan helper (src/lib/xbrief/issue-plan-lookup.ts) checks local workspace -> refs/heads/feature/<id> -> refs/remotes/origin/feature/<id> -> primary checkout, with no network I/O; start.ts uses it and checks the local workspace even under --remote. (2) New pushFeatureBranch helper pushes with an explicit refspec `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feature/<id>` (no -u, no --no-verify, no --force); complete-planning calls it after its last plan commit and reports the real gitPushed; createRemoteWorkspace calls it before creating the VM and aborts on failure. (3) The auto-start consent record carries workspaceLocation (mirroring workModel, PAN-3022); a consent-bearing POST /api/agents with consent location 'remote' and no remote metadata spawns `pan start <id> --remote` and skips local-only steps. (4) Docs: docs/fly-provider.md, features/workspaces.mdx, docs/XBRIEF.md. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-4683.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running git fetch during plan lookup (a stale origin view still falls through to planning).
- Polyrepo plan homes on branch refs, and pushing a nested pan_records.repo spec repo.
- Running planning itself on Fly, or changing `pan plan --remote`.
- A new workspaceLocation field in the POST /api/agents body, or any dashboard UI for choosing a location.
- Pushing uncommitted workspace changes to the VM.
- Setting or changing the feature branch upstream (`git push -u`), or changing how worktrees are created/tracked.
- Bypassing git hooks (--no-verify) or force-pushing on any push.
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan lookup order: local workspace, local feature branch ref, origin feature branch ref, primary checkout; first hit wins.
autoDecisions.rationale: The spec is committed on feature/<id>; the workspace is the freshest copy, branch refs cover a removed workspace, and the primary checkout keeps today's behavior as the last resort.

autoDecisions.summary: No git fetch during plan lookup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Adding network I/O to every pan start is not worth it; a stale origin view falls through to re-planning, which is today's behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix both push points: complete-planning (non-fatal) and createRemoteWorkspace (fatal, before VM creation).
autoDecisions.rationale: The remote-creator push covers 'planned days ago, pan start --remote today'; the complete-planning fix makes the existing 'pushed to git' response honest and matches the code's original intent.

autoDecisions.summary: Push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feature/<id>`: no -u, no --no-verify, no --force, 120 s timeout.
autoDecisions.rationale: -u would retarget @{u}, which git-state/continue-state/lanes read as origin/main; hooks are guards and must not be bypassed; never rewrite remote history.

autoDecisions.summary: The work-agent location travels on the auto-start consent record, not a new /api/agents body field.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the existing workModel pattern (PAN-3022) and covers the deferred hand-off retry with no caller change.

autoDecisions.summary: The /api/agents route starts a remote work agent by spawning `pan start <id> --remote` through its existing detached spawnPanCommand path.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses handleRemoteWorkspace end to end (VM create, clone, checkout, spawn) and keeps multi-minute VM creation out of the HTTP request.

autoDecisions.summary: Consent says remote but remote is disabled: the route returns HTTP 422 with an actionable message.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fail loudly instead of silently starting locally, which is the bug being fixed.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the dirty-tree refusal for remote spawns when the local workspace exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: Uncommitted changes would not reach the VM, so refusing is the correct outcome.

items.title: Add findIssuePlan helper that finds a spec in the workspace, on feature branch refs, or on the primary checkout

expected_outputs: issue-plan-lookup.test.ts passes including the branch-only and origin-only cases

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/xbrief/issue-plan-lookup.ts exporting `async function findIssuePlan(input: { issueId: string; projectRoot: string; localWorkspace: string | null }): Promise<string | null>` per PRD WI-1. Do NOT add it to io.ts (start-running-noop.test.ts mocks io.js with only findPlanSync). Order: (1) localWorkspace exists -> findPlanSync(localWorkspace) if non-null; (2) for ref in refs/heads/feature/<id-lower>, refs/remotes/origin/feature/<id-lower>: promisified execFile `git -c core.quotePath=false ls-tree --name-only --full-name <ref> -- .pan/specs/` in projectRoot, any git error = no match, keep lines under .pan/specs/ whose basename parseXBriefFilename()s to the same issue id (case-insensitive), return `${ref}:${firstSorted}`; (3) return (await Effect.runPromise(findSpecByIssue(projectRoot, issueId)))?.path ?? null using findSpecByIssue from ../pan-dir/specs.js. No git fetch. Tests use real git fixtures in mkdtemp dirs and buildPanSpecFilename() for names: branch-only, origin-only (bare origin + clone, local branch deleted), workspace file, other-issue spec -> null, nothing -> null.

Add pushFeatureBranch helper that pushes feature/<id> with an explicit refspec

expected_outputs: feature-branch-push.test.ts passes including the real git fixture case

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/overdeck/feature-branch-push.ts exporting `pushFeatureBranch(input: { cwd: string; branch: string; execImpl?: typeof execFileAsync }): Promise<{ pushed: boolean; reason?: string }>` per PRD WI-3. Steps: `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD` (error -> pushed:false 'HEAD is detached'); HEAD branch !== input.branch -> pushed:false 'HEAD is on <x>, expected <branch>'; `git remote` lacks an `origin` line -> pushed:false 'no origin remote'; `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` with timeout 120000 -> pushed:true; error -> pushed:false with the first stderr line. NEVER -u, --no-verify or --force; never throws. Async execFile only (dashboard-reachable). Tests: real fixture (bare origin.git, clone, `git worktree add -b feature/pan-9003 ../ws origin/main`, commit) proves the push lands and branch.feature/pan-9003.merge stays refs/heads/main; execImpl spy asserts exact args; wrong-branch and rejected-push cases.

items.title: Given a worktree branch feature/pan-9003 tracking origin/main with a new commit, when pushFeatureBranch runs, then it returns { pushed: true } and `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feature/pan-9003` prints the worktree HEAD sha
After that push, `git config --get branch.feature/pan-9003.merge` still prints refs/heads/main (upstream preserved)
Given an execImpl spy, when pushFeatureBranch pushes feature/pan-9003, then the recorded push args are exactly ['push', 'origin', 'HEAD:refs/heads/feature/pan-9003']
Given HEAD on another branch, pushFeatureBranch returns { pushed: false } and issues no push; given a rejected push, it returns { pushed: false, reason } without throwing
Replace complete-planning's detached bare git push with an awaited pushFeatureBranch call

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4 in src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts: (1) delete the remotes/spawn('git', ['push']) try/catch from commitCompletePlanningWorkspaceGit; it now returns Promise<{ taskWarning: string | null }> (pre-worktree early return becomes `return { taskWarning };`); change line 1 to `import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';` (spawn has no other use). (2) Add 'branchPush' to the CompletePlanningPhase union. (3) In completePlanningForIssue, after the `if (effectiveAutoSpawn && workspacePath) { await commitWorkspacePlanArtifacts(...) }` block and before completePlanningAutoSpawnAndKill, call pushFeatureBranch({ cwd: workspacePath, branch: `feature/${issueLower}` }) when workspacePath has a .git entry (else { pushed: false, reason: 'no workspace git checkout' }), emit the branchPush phase success/failure, and set gitPushed from push.pushed for the response. Push failure never fails finalize. Never call pushPlanArtifacts from a workspace (it targets main). File must stay <= 995 lines. Update the commitCompletePlanningWorkspaceGit tests in complete-planning.test.ts: expect { taskWarning: null } and assert no recorded call has args[0] === 'push'. The 995-line limit is a self-imposed buffer (the file-size gate itself allows up to 1000); the change nets negative, so it should hold.
